Weddings & events, under one roof — and under the open sky

Elite Marquee sits on Airport Road in DHA Phase 8, Lahore, by the Ex Park View Block F gate — easy to reach from DHA, Cantt and the airport side of the city. The venue offers both an indoor marquee hall and an outdoor event space, so the same celebration can move from a decorated hall to an open-air evening without changing address.

From full wedding functions to family gatherings and company events, the space is used for barat, walima, mehndi, birthdays and corporate events — with spacious parking for guests arriving by car.

Two ways to celebrate

Pick the setting that fits your event — a draped indoor hall, or the open air.

The Indoor Hall

A full marquee hall with a decorated stage, chandelier lighting and formal seating — the classic setting for barat and walima receptions, whatever the weather outside.

The Outdoor Space

An open-air event area for evening functions — mehndis, birthdays and gatherings that feel better under lights and open sky than between four walls.
